patch.caveat: This concerns removal/demolition within EU scope, not every low-risk activity. An existing valid undertaking permit may satisfy EU Article 15 even when a particular job needs no notification. National Section 6(4), consistent interpretation and permit practice may constrain the exception. General prevention, exposure limits, training and health surveillance remain. This supports a potentially narrower administrative reading.
